name: Himawari no Saku Machi
source:
Dreaming of being reunited with a girl from his far-off memories, the protagonist comes to the public bath house “Koinoyu”. When he arrives he finds out his uncle is leaving on a sudden honeymoon, forcing him to stay and take care of the bath and the attached boarding house.

Furthermore, the boarding house only has female tenants! They look cute, but every one of them is a weirdo with one or two screws loose. He spends his busy days being ordered around by them...

This romance with quirky girls is filled with heart-pounding events that live up to the “Fairytale” name. The girls are all so charming you won't know who to pick! Is the “girl of your memories” one of them, or...?

[Translation of synopsis from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=10024]Getchu.com[/url]]
